newsitem.title: USA: Collins & Aikman says period expired.
newsitem.headline: Collins & Aikman says period expired.

text.p: Collins & Aikman Products Inc on Monday said the waiting period under the Hart-Scott-Rodino Act applicable to its agreement to acquire JPS Automotive LP had expired.

JPS Automotive is a subsidiary of Foamex International Inc. The closing of the transaction is subject to a number of other conditions, including the execution of supply agreements with Foamex, the arrangement of certain standby financing, lender and Foamex bondholder consents, and the purchase of a minority interest in a JPS Automotive subsidiary.

Collins & Aikman Corp is a major supplier of textile and plastic interior trim products and convertible top systems to the North American automotive industry, and a leading manufacturer of residential upholstery fabrics.
